summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by ensuring that HttpResponseNotAllowed is returned directly without attempting to await it, which resolves the TypeError.

issues.description: The patch may introduce behavioral regression risk by altering how responses are handled in the middleware chain. It assumes that HttpResponseNotAllowed should be returned directly without further processing, which might not be the intended behavior in all cases.
The patch could benefit from additional comments explaining why HttpResponseNotAllowed is being returned directly, to improve maintainability and readability.
